title: Stock market today: Dow ekes out third straight record, S&P 500, Nasdaq slide with jobs report on deck

title: Big Tech reports lower tax bills from Trump's Big Beautiful Bill
title_zh: 大型科技公司报告特朗普的美丽法案降低了税单
summary: Big Tech companies and major AI players, including Amazon (AMZN), Meta Platforms (META), and Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), are seeing lower tax bills for 2025 tied to President Trump's Big Beautiful Bill legislation.
summary_zh: 大型科技公司和主要人工智能公司，包括亚马逊 (AMZN)、Meta Platforms (META) 和 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL)，预计 2025 年税单将因特朗普总统的《美丽法案》立法而降低。

title: The big question investors ask about AI spend: 'Is it paying off?'
title_zh: 投资者对人工智能支出提出的一个大问题是：“它有回报吗？”
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are mixed ahead of Tuesday's closing bell as the tech sector continues to search for solid footing after last week's software sell-off triggered by broadening AI concerns.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周二收盘前涨跌互现，科技股在上周因人工智能担忧扩大引发软件抛售后继续寻找坚实的基础。
